v0.9.0-beta.summary: v0.9.0-beta is the biggest release in ALL OF Slackzilla's history, introducing the new React dashboard, repository-aware RAG, expanded APIs, telemetry, command execution, and a major dashboard architecture overhaul.
changes: migrated the dashboard from EJS to React with Vite and React Router
renamed `src/` to `bot/` (since before it was just intended to be a simple bot, but now it has a dashboard, APIS and A FRIGGEN RAG MODEL)
overhauled the dashboard UI/UX and introduced a new component-based architecture
added 10 dashboard pages covering Home, Admin, API, Commands, Docs, Logs, AI, Sitemap, and Status
added loads of new React components including a dedicated 404 page and Error Boundary
added a repository-aware RAG system for answering questions about the Slackzilla codebase
added the `/sz-ask` & `/api/ask` to question the repository-aware AI assistant
added command APIs for listing, viewing, and executing Slackzilla commands
added stable command IDs, command help, and captured command responses to the command API
added CPU, memory, disk, and network telemetry with responsive graphs w hover tooltips
added admin feedback controls for filtering, viewing, replying, marking read or unread, and deleting feedback
documented authentication, CSRF, webhook, API registration, setup, and RAG behaviour in `docs/`
separated the React client build from the server using `server/client/src/` and `server/client/dist/`
introduced explicit Node HTTP API handlers under `server/api/`
added related image asset detection to RAG without parsing binary image contents

v0.9.1-beta.summary: v0.9.1-beta - added AST-based codebase intelligence & dependency analysis for RAG
changes: added 2 new core dependencies `acorn` & `acorn-walk` for javascript AST parsing and walking
added `npm run build` to `deploy.sh` for the webhook to build the react app before restarting the server
added `code-parser.js` to extract `exports`, `functions`, `function calls`, `env variables`, and `routes`
RAG: added persistent `.rag/index.json` containing file metadata, chunks, tokens, file types, and AST structure
RAG: replaced token-based search with an indexed, code-aware retrieval system
RAG: added codebase indexing, file references, symbol search, dependency analysis, and automatic index rebuilding
RAG: added richer code context, source metadata, API route discovery, environment variable lookup, and improved image retrieval

v0.9.2-beta.summary: v0.9.2-beta removed/cleaned up unused EJS & pages dependencies and files
changes: removed 3 core dependencies `@openrouter/sdk`, `ejs` & `requests`
removed 4 dev dependencies `clean-css`, `terser`, `terser-brunch`, `html-minifier-terser`
removed the `pages` folder and all its contents (`scripts/build-pages.js`, `server/lib/pages.js`)

v0.9.2.1-beta.summary: v0.9.2.1-beta fixed several bugs affecting bot metadata, RAG privacy controls, and command usage hints
changes: (/sz-info) fixed the bot not accessing the bot meta information outside of the process causing api to fail when retrieving the bot meta information
added an anonymous code flag to RAG (/sz-ask) to prevent the bot from storing the question in the logs (rn its on for testing purposes)
fixed `Commands.jsx` not displaying usage hints for commands that have them

v0.9.3-beta.summary: v0.9.3-beta - migrated to chart.js for status page
changes: on `.vscode/launch.json` added a new launch config for launching the server instead of manually typing npm start in the terminal
added 2 new core dependencies `chart.js` & `react-chartjs-2
migrated from svg telemetary graph to chart.js in Status Page
improved Status Page UI/UX

v0.9.4-beta.summary: v0.9.4-beta offers more advanced logs filtering & navigation, and RAG enhancements (also fixed some bugs)
changes: added navigation controls
fixed the sidebar active page not receiving the active class
fixed the download button displaying plain text instead of downloading
fixed the bot showing offline on the sidebar (by adding the state property default)
made page state load dynamically/automatically when the page is initialised
registered `/webhook` route to `api-routes.js` (yes still that script is just documentaton for now..)
LOGS: Added line jumping with ?line=21
LOGS: Added log filtering with ?q=filter+text
LOGS: Added First Line, Prev 100, Next 100 and Latest buttons
LOGS: Newly added logs are now highlighted
CMDS: Added /sz-release utility command to check for the latest release notes
CMDS: token now defaults to 32 if the 2nd argument is incorrect instead of throwing an error
added `release-history.json` so /sz-release 2nd arg can pull the release history
RAG: Added an emitActivity event thatll tell what actions the bot is doing (e.g. fetching, generating, etc.)
RAG: Added a withAi flag to `askQuestion` so i can debug and see some of the context is being sent to the AI model
RAG: added 2 new functions `resolveFileReference` and `extractPathReferences` to detect path-based dependencies inside code
